<div class="card-body">
'''Collapsing Corridor''' is a [[Dark]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊通路の崩壊</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分がＡＴ－ＡＴを最も内側のマーカーに移動した直後に使用する。ホスの地下位置を１つ目標とする。運命数を引く。運命数＞マーカー・ナンバーなら、目標は“崩壊”する。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Collapsing-Corridor-PSA-152940013.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">エコー基地の大部分は、広大な氷河に反乱軍の技師たちが掘抜いたトンネルから成り立っている。氷でできた通路は帝国軍の砲撃に耐えられるほど頑丈ではない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Collapse of the corridor.

'''Card text:'''
Use immediately after you move an AT-AT to the innermost marker. Target one underground Hoth site. Draw destiny. The target 'collapses' if destiny > marker number.

'''Lore:'''
Most of Echo Base consists of tunnels Rebel engineers dug through a vast glacier. Its icy corridors are not strong enough to withstand Imperial shelling.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Collapsing Corridor]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
